newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude slips in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude slips in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: Brent crude oil, the North Sea benchmark, slipped in late U.S. paper activity, traders said.
A full boat of July Brent traded at $19.43 a barrel, down six cents from the settlement of London's IPE.
Five partial July cargoes changed hands, three at $19.45 and two at $19.43 a barrel, traders said.
Intermonth spreads were subdued. June/July was talked at minus one cent to flat, while July/August and August/September were each talked at minus three cents to flat, traders said.
